pages.title: Cambridge & Oxford Admissions Advice
pages.heading: Preparing for mathematical admissions.
pages.description: Practical Cambridge and Oxford application advice for Maths, Engineering and Computer Science: subjects, tests, interviews and free independent preparation.
pages.lede: Understand the requirements, choose worthwhile problems and make a plan you can actually follow. Guidance for students and parents, with official sources and room for independent thinking.
pages.searchIntent: Find trustworthy course-specific guidance and choose the right next resource.
related: What a Cambridge maths interview is like

pages.title: Cambridge Maths: Entry Requirements, TMUA and STEP
pages.heading: Applying for Mathematics at Cambridge.
pages.description: Cambridge Maths entry requirements for 2027: Further Maths, three or four A levels, TMUA, STEP, interviews and a sensible preparation plan.
pages.lede: A strong application grows out of doing mathematics carefully. Here is how the subject choices, TMUA, interviews and STEP fit together, and what is worth your time.
pages.searchIntent: Understand requirements and plan Cambridge Mathematics preparation.

pages.title: Oxford Maths Guide: TMUA and Further Maths
pages.heading: Applying for Mathematics at Oxford.
pages.description: Oxford Maths requirements for 2027 entry, the switch from MAT to TMUA, Further Maths, A levels, interviews and practical independent preparation.
pages.lede: Choose this course because you want to explore mathematics in depth. Preparation should help you reason with unfamiliar ideas, not collect application credentials.
pages.searchIntent: Check Oxford Mathematics requirements, new test and preparation priorities.
related: Historical MAT questions for extra practice

pages.title: Cambridge Engineering: ESAT, Subjects and Interviews
pages.heading: Applying for Engineering at Cambridge.
pages.description: Cambridge Engineering requirements for 2027: Maths, Physics, Further Maths, four A levels, ESAT modules, interviews and free preparation resources.
pages.lede: The useful preparation is mathematical and physical: build a model, explain an assumption and work out what changes when the situation changes.
pages.searchIntent: Plan subject choices, ESAT and interviews for Cambridge Engineering.
related: Preparing without a general admissions agency

pages.title: Oxford Engineering Science: ESAT and Further Maths
pages.heading: Applying for Engineering Science at Oxford.
pages.description: Oxford Engineering Science requirements for 2027: ESAT replaces PAT, Further Maths is helpful but not required, plus interviews and preparation advice.
pages.lede: Start with the mathematics and physics that let you explain how something works. A convincing application does not need an expensive project or a polished sales pitch.
pages.searchIntent: Understand Oxford Engineering subjects, ESAT and interview preparation.

pages.title: Cambridge Computer Science: TMUA and Further Maths
pages.heading: Applying for Computer Science at Cambridge.
pages.description: Cambridge Computer Science requirements for 2027: Maths, Further Maths, TMUA, college CSAT, interviews, projects and independent preparation.
pages.lede: This is a mathematical Computer Science course. Clear reasoning and an interest in how algorithms work matter more than the size or appearance of a programming portfolio.
pages.searchIntent: Check Cambridge CS mathematical requirements, tests and project preparation.

pages.title: Cambridge vs Oxford Maths: Courses, TMUA and STEP
pages.heading: Cambridge or Oxford for Mathematics?
pages.description: Compare Cambridge and Oxford Maths: course structure, entry requirements, Further Maths, TMUA, STEP and interviews for 2027 entry.
pages.lede: Both courses require serious mathematical engagement. Choose by the mathematics you want to study and the application route you are prepared to follow, rather than a prestige ranking.
pages.searchIntent: Compare course fit and admissions routes before choosing one university.

pages.title: Cambridge vs Oxford Engineering: Courses and ESAT
pages.heading: Cambridge or Oxford for Engineering?
pages.description: Compare Cambridge Engineering and Oxford Engineering Science: broad courses, Further Maths expectations, ESAT modules and interviews for 2027 entry.
pages.lede: Both begin broadly and develop specialist choices later. The most useful comparison is the course you would actually study, including its mathematical demands and practical work.
pages.searchIntent: Compare course content, subject expectations and assessment routes.

pages.title: Do You Need an Oxbridge Admissions Consultancy?
pages.heading: Do you need an admissions consultancy?
pages.description: Can you prepare for Cambridge or Oxford independently? A practical guide to free official resources, specialist tutoring and avoiding unnecessary costs.
pages.lede: Usually, I would start without a general admissions agency. First establish what the course requires, what you can do independently and whether there is a specific difficulty that needs help.
pages.cardTitle: Do you need an admissions consultancy?
pages.primaryKeyword: do I need an Oxbridge admissions consultancy
pages.searchIntent: Decide whether paid help adds value and build a free preparation plan.
related: Free paper archives and preparation guides
